lines: High above the clouds, Ravana's golden flying chariot raced towards Lanka.
Ha ha ha! No one can stop Ravana!
But the mighty bird Jatayu, friend of King Dasharatha, heard her cry.
Jatayu attacked with his claws and wings, and broke Ravana's chariot.
Then Ravana raised his sword, and cut Jatayu's wing.
Jatayu fell to the earth, and Ravana flew away with Sita.
But brave Jatayu held on to life, to tell Rama the truth.
Jatayu gave his life protecting Sita. The bravest heart in the sky.
